criteria.evidence: Exact clean main target, line-ending policy, tracked-file inventory, and secret/generated exclusions were rechecked.
Node 22.14.0 and pnpm 11.25.0 are pinned and passed local, Linux, and hosted toolchain checks.
Independent Windows and native-volume Debian checkouts matched the target and completed setup without undocumented project tools.
Frozen installs passed from the committed lockfile on Windows, Linux, and Hosted CI without lockfile changes.
The root verify command passed on both developer and clean Linux paths and in Hosted CI.
The workspace remains limited to the Phase 0 API, worker, and justified foundation packages; no functional domain placeholder was found.
Format, lint, strict typecheck, and all five build tasks passed.
The real graph has zero violations and compiling forbidden dependency, alias, re-export, deep-import, and dynamic-import fixtures are detected.
Direct process environment access remains confined to packages/config/src/environment.ts; reflective aliases are rejected.
ADR-001 through ADR-010 remain Accepted and survived source, test, database, and workflow consistency checks.
Configuration tests and the intentionally incomplete audit invocation confirm fail-fast validation without secret values.
Unsafe production defaults, wildcard credentialed CORS, and example-secret forms remain rejected by the configuration suite.
Current-tree/reachable-history scans and both hosted artifact samples report zero secrets; examples remain non-usable.
Final Pino-byte attacks covered 21 key classes, casing variants, strings, nesting, arrays, Error/cause/AggregateError, URLs, encodings, and subsystem diagnostics with zero canary leaks.
Safe exception unit/integration tests retain the stable request-ID envelope without stack, query, path, or input disclosure.
Live dependency audit and hosted filesystem/image reports contain zero Critical, High, Moderate, or other advisories/findings.
The digest-pinned PostgreSQL 17/PostGIS 3.5 image rebuilt without cache and became healthy as user 70:70.
Four migrations applied to disposable empty databases and repeat execution was a no-op.
Rollback/roll-forward, invalid migration rollback, checksum/prefix integrity, and concurrent serialization passed on real PostgreSQL.
A physical restricted runtime login was denied DDL, role escalation, and unauthorized outbox operations.
No product/domain table or Villa Altagracia runtime hardcoding was found in the foundation surface.
Compiled API and worker processes emitted structured lifecycle logs, received real SIGTERM, drained, and stopped within bounds.
Liveness independence and readiness failure/recovery against real PostgreSQL passed.
Health and error responses remained free of secrets, topology, dependency exception text, and configuration.
Valid request/correlation IDs propagate and malformed, oversized, and control-character inputs are safely replaced.
Final log bytes, low-risk telemetry fields, and bounded exporter failure/hang behavior passed adversarial regression.
Body/header/URL/request/readiness/shutdown bounds and process-tree grace/force intervals remain explicit and tested.
Windows verification passed 75 tests with one POSIX-only skip; Linux passed 76/76 and integration passed 19/19 locally and hosted.
Integration and DB suites used isolated disposable databases on real PostgreSQL/PostGIS and were repeatable.
Invalid config, DB loss, telemetry loss, malformed/oversized input, migration failure, timeout, and shutdown paths passed.

PR/main and push/main triggers, least permissions, timeouts, SHA pins, and required jobs are verified; live read-back shows no production deployment/environment or second merge-capable collaborator, so documented reopening triggers remain absent.
Both hosted runs retain quality, integration, and security artifacts; all six archives were independently inspected.
Setup, architecture, configuration, migrations, testing, security, observability, and operations documentation match executed behavior.
Implementation and the audit/remediation chain map AC-001 through AC-033 to concrete retained or reproduced evidence.
This final independent adversarial audit records all results; the five blocking findings are CLOSED and no Critical, High, or blocking Medium remains.

The historical failed AUDIT.md remains immutable while FINAL-AUDIT.md is the truthful terminal report with counts, residual risks, evidence, and PASS, as explicitly required by the final-audit authorization.
